governance.parent: Ministry of Culture of the Slovak Republic

basis: The founding charter in force from 1 January 2020 (Article III and Article V) names it a state contributory organisation founded by the Ministry of Culture whose director the minister appoints after a selection procedure; the Supreme Audit Office report on 2022 to 2024 audited it and records its procurement law duties.

The Culture.si entry describes Kersnikova Institute as a not-for-profit cultural institution founded by the Student Organisation of the University of Ljubljana and managing Kapelica Gallery; its December 2024 notice shows a council (Svet zavoda) under the Institutes Act and its statute.

Annual report 2025, pages 2 and 4, states it is a public institute (javni zavod) founded by the City of Ljubljana by decree and lists the Public Employees Act and the public sector pay system among its legal bases.

The freedom of information catalogue on its own site, sections 2 to 4, names it a public institute (javni zavod) founded by the Republic of Slovenia with a council and director, and lists the Public Employees Act among its regulations.
The About page, section 'Who is A4?', says it is a private foundation with one patron, Wendy Fisher, established as an NPC in 2015.
